page.overview:
What is Cry of the Broken King?

The Cry of the Broken King was a Force power. the murder of the Sarravi V'Kara the Sephi thief Tey Sirrek was spotted standing next to the Sarravi's corpse by the Kiffar Vildar Mac, who had chased Sirrek after seeing him steal from a Bpfasshi Truthsayer. Thinking Sirrek had killed V'Kara, Mac confronted him, attempting to strike him down with his lightsaber. After Sirrek managed to dodge all of Mac's stikes, the annoyed Jedi asked how he was doing so.

Sirrek then claimed to have mastered many Force powers, including the Cry of the Broken King, Vitali and Morichro. Mac dismissed that as nonsense, stating that Morichro was nothing more than a myth. The Sephi then used biological pheromones his ancestors had developed for usage against predators to temporarily knock out Mac, while claiming that he was using Morichro on the Jedi.

The Cry of the Broken King was mentioned in the first issue of the 2022 comic series Star Wars: The High Republic published as part of the Star Wars: The High Republic multimedia project's The issue was written by Cavan Scott, and published by Marvel Comics on October 12, 2022.
